title: New arrangements beyond defensive assumptions

captions.physics: Acting with regard to unknown conditions
captions.energy: Keeping earlier rules to preserve certainty
captions.emotions: Experiencing an outdated domestic form ending

meaning: Your domestic support helps release the outdated when rules answer present conditions and assumptions about change do not retain an unsuitable form.
text: A domestic change may seem necessary to you and insufficiently clear at the same time. The Moon in the physical position of Muladhara appears through actions shaped by unknown conditions. The Emperor in energy can retain earlier rules for a sense of certainty, while Death in emotions already experiences an outdated form ending. Both continue maintaining arrangements they are inwardly ready to leave: uncertainty about the new seems sufficient reason to preserve the familiar even when its usefulness for present life is doubtful.

For example, a separate desk has long stood unused, but a strict storage scheme remains built around it. You want the space freed yet assume that without this desk every paper will inevitably be lost. **An unknown new method does not prove an outdated one must stay.** Checking which documents are actually needed and where they fit lets an ending be discussed specifically, without promising faultless order in advance or requiring everything to disappear immediately.

The difficulty is awaiting a complete guarantee before every change. The earlier form stays compulsory, and wanting to finish with it becomes continual irritation. Support grows when an assumption can be distinguished from a known need. Both need not know the whole future routine to acknowledge the outdated and find a manageable transition in which important belongings and responsibility still have a place.
